content: Kemɨtiwarumi 'auxɨwime miriyari
Merikɨtsɨ yapaɨmexɨa 'anukayaku Ketsutsi kaneyani, Karereya harakunayaritsie Tiweriya mɨrakutewatsie 'anutaɨye kaneta'ani.
Yumɨiretɨ mekanikuweiyatɨwekaitɨni teɨteri 'inɨarite memɨxeiyakaikɨ kemɨtiyurienekai tekwikwikate wahetsie.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi hɨritsie kaneutiyune, mana kanetayerɨni, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemamata hamatɨana mekanetitekaitɨni.
Merikɨtsɨ huriyutsixi wa'ixɨarari Patsikwa mɨtitewa kanahurakaitɨni.
Hikɨ kepauka Ketsutsi munierixɨ, meta yumɨireme muwaruxei hepana me'ahume, mɨpaɨ Peripe katiniutahɨawe: —¿Hakewa tepeinanaiyu paa 'ikɨ memɨtekwanikɨ?
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni 'i'inɨatanetɨ, mɨkɨ tsietɨ katinimaikaitɨniri kemɨtiyurienikekai.
Hikɨ Peripe mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Paa huta tsienituyari 'inɨariyaritsie 'atɨ pɨkatinake wahetsiemieme yuxexuitɨ 'etsiwa xeikɨa memita'ɨixɨanikɨ.
Xewitɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama 'Atɨrexi mɨtitewakai Tsimuni Pekuru 'iwaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
—'Ena puyeika xewitɨ temaikɨ tsewara payari 'auxɨwime hexeiyatɨ meta tsapari yuhutame. ¿Perutsɨ 'ikɨ tixaɨtɨ pɨkatihɨkɨ yumɨireme wahetsiemieme?
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xekeniwaranukayatsa teɨteri. Mana waɨkawa kanaku'ɨxayakaitɨni. Hikɨ 'ukitsi mekananukayaxe 'auxɨwime miriyari meyupaɨmetɨ 'etsiwatɨkaku.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi kanenu'ɨni paa, pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨaka Kakaɨyari katiniwarumini mana memɨtitekai. Yaxeikɨata tsapari kaniwarumini kememɨtewareukwaikukai.
Hikɨ me'utihuxaku mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete: —Xekeneukuxeɨri tarimeyari muyuhayewaxɨ kapa reuyewenikɨ.
'Ayumieme mekanikuxeɨrieni, tamamata heimana huta tsikɨiwitiyari mekaniutihɨniya tarimeyari tekwa'amete memiku'eiri 'auxɨwime tsewara payaritsie mieme.
Merikɨtsɨ teɨteri me'ixeiyaka 'inɨarikɨ kemɨtiuyuri mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Kaniyuritɨni 'ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari niukameya kwiepa 'umamiekai».
Hikɨ retimaika Ketsutsi kename me'axɨanikekai me'iwiyake tiwa'aitɨwame memayeitɨanikɨ, tawarita yuxaɨta mana hɨritsie kaneutiyune.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuyeikakai harakunatsie
Merikɨtsɨ kepauka tau makayunixɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mana mekaniukanexɨani harakuna mayema paitɨ.
Kanuwatsie mekayaxeka harakunatsie me'uhukaku 'anutaɨye mehanɨkɨneke Kaperunaume paitɨ meye'axɨanike. Hikɨ kaniukuyɨrekaitɨniri Ketsutsi 'akuxi wahetsɨa pɨkanuawekai.
Karima mu'ekakaikɨ harakunatsie hamewari waɨkawa kanixuawekaitɨni.
Hikɨ yateewa 'auxɨwi yatɨni 'ataxewi kirumeturuyari me'uhutɨ kanuwa me'uwekirɨmetɨ mekanixeiya Ketsutsi harakunatsie 'umiekame kanuwatsie 'aye'aximeme, hikɨ mekaniutimamani.
Peru mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Ne nepɨyɨane. Xepɨkamamaka».
Hikɨ mekanipitɨani kanuwatsie mɨkayerɨnikɨ. Yapauka kanuwa kaneutaneni kwiepa hakewa memeukɨnekai.
Teɨteri kememɨte'ikuwautɨwekai Ketsutsi

Merikɨtsɨ 'uxa'arieka teɨteri harakuna 'anutaɨye memɨti'ukai mekaniuneniere mana mukateikɨ xewitɨ kanuwa xeikɨa. Mepunenierixɨ Ketsutsi mɨka'akayerɨwekai mɨkɨ kanuwatsie teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahamatɨa, matsi teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yuxaɨtame memekɨnekaikɨ.
Hipatɨta kanuwate mekaneyekɨne Tiweriya. Mana 'ahurawa mekaniu'axɨani hakewa paa memetikwaitsie Ti'aitame pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨaku Kakaɨyari.
Me'uneniereka teɨteri Ketsutsi mana mɨka'uyeikakaikɨ, meta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mana memɨka'u'uwakaikɨ, mɨkɨtari kanuwatetsie mekayaxeka mekanekɨne Kaperunaume paitɨ Ketsutsi mekuwautɨwetɨ.
Ketsutsi paa tukari tiyupitɨwame pɨhɨkɨ
Harakuna 'anutaɨye meheitaxeiyaka mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame, ¿kepauka pepunua 'uwapaitɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, xepɨkanetsikuwautɨwe 'inɨarite xemuxeikɨ. Paa xemetikwaikɨ xemetihuxaikɨ pɨta xepɨnetsikuwautɨwe.

Xepɨkate'uximayaka 'ikwai mɨtipɨniwe xema'iwakɨ xeikɨa. Xeketene'uximayaka pɨta xeme'iwakɨ 'ikwai 'amɨtiteriwe tukari mɨkaxɨwe mɨxepitɨatsie Yuri Tewi mɨtixemini. 'Ukiyarieya Kakaɨyaritɨtɨ mɨkɨ kaniu'inɨaritɨani.
'Ayumieme mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Keri teteyurieka Kakaɨyari 'uximayatsikayatsie temɨte'uximayakakɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari 'uximayatsikaya: yuri xemɨte'eriekakɨ mɨkɨ meiyenɨ'atsie.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Merikɨte, tita 'inɨari petiyuriene, temixeiyakɨ, yuri temɨmeteta'eririenikɨ. Kepemɨtiu'uximayata.
Tame tatutsima manana payari mekanikwakaitɨni makumawetsie, kemɨre'uxa: “Hatsi muyuawitsie mieme kaniwarumini”.

Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, Muitsexi pɨkahɨkɨtɨkai kemɨ'ane mɨxe'umi mɨkɨ paa taheima mieme. Ne'ukiyari pɨta katinixemikwani tita yurikɨ paa mɨtihɨkɨ taheima mieme.
Kemɨ'ane taheima makaneika, tukari mɨwamikwa kwiepa memɨtama, mɨkɨtɨtɨ paa kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitawawirieni: —Ti'aitame, 'aheyemekɨ yaketatineumikwani mɨkɨ paa.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Ne nekanihɨkɨtɨni paa tukari tiyupitɨwame. Kemɨ'ane nehetsɨa mɨye'ani pɨkaheuhakamɨkɨni meta kemɨ'ane nehetsie yuri mɨti'erie hawaikɨ pɨkaheuharimɨkɨni hatsuaku.
Matsi yanepɨtixekɨhɨawekai, xepɨnetsixeiya peru yuri xepɨkate'erie.
Naime ne'ukiyari mɨnetipitɨa nehetsɨa pɨye'ani. Kemɨ'ane nehetsɨa mɨye'ani, takwa nepɨka'enuyehɨani.
Ne taheima nepɨka'akane tita mɨnetinake yanemɨtiyurienenikɨ, matsi tita mɨtinake 'iya mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a pɨta yanemɨtiyurienenikɨ.
'Ipaɨ katininakeni 'iya mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a, naime mɨnetiupitɨa nixeime nemɨkaheuyehɨanikɨ, matsi nemenukuketɨanikɨ tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtapare.
'Ipaɨrita katininakeni ne'ukiyari, yunaitɨ memixeiya nu'aya, yuri memɨte'erie hetsiena, tukari mɨkaxɨwe memexeiyanikɨ. Ne nepɨwaranuku'uitɨani tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtapare.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi mekaniniukixiekaitɨni hepaɨtsitana mɨpaɨ mutayɨkɨ: «Ne paa nekanihɨkɨtɨni taheima makane».
Mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «¿'Ikɨ Ketsutsi katihɨkɨ Kutse nu'aya? Tame paapaya meta maamaya tepɨwamate. ¿Ketɨtɨ putaine: “Ne taheima nepakane”?»
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xepɨkaniukixieka yutsata.
Xewitɨ pɨkayɨwe nehetsɨa mɨye'ani, xɨka ne'ukiyari mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a 'enayexeiya xeikɨa pɨyɨwe. Ne tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtapare nekanenukuketɨamɨkɨ.
Kakaɨyari niukametema waxapatsie mɨpaɨ katine'uka: “Kakaɨyari katiniwa'ɨkitɨaka yunaime”. Yunaitɨ memɨ'enana ne'ukiyari kemaine, memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa, mɨkɨ nehetsɨa mekaniye'axɨakuni.
Perutsɨ xewitɨ pɨka'ixeiyawe ne'ukiyari. Kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari hetsɨa miemetɨtɨ 'amuyeika, mɨkɨ xeikɨa kanixeiyaweni ne'ukiyari.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, kemɨ'ane nehetsie yuri mɨti'erie, tukari mɨkaxɨwe kanexeiyani.
Ne paa tukari tiyupitɨwame nekanihɨkɨtɨni.
Xetutsima manana payari mekanikwakaitɨni makumawetsie, peru mɨkɨ mekaniukwini.
Peru 'ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni paa mayeniere taheima makane tewi mitikwanikɨ mɨkamɨnikɨ.
Ne nekanihɨkɨtɨni paa mayeniere taheima makane. Xɨka tewi 'ikɨ paa 'utikwani, yuheyemekɨ payeniereni. 'Ikɨ paa nemɨyetuani ne, newaiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni, kwiepa memɨtama watukari mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi mekaniyuxamurietɨwekaitɨni yameteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ: «¿Ketiyɨwe 'ikɨ yuwaiyari mɨtatsiminikɨ temitikwanikɨ?»
Ketsutsi 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, xɨka xeka'itikwani Yuri Tewi waiyarieya, xɨka xuriyaya xeka'anu'ieni, tukari yuhetsie xepɨkahexeiya.
Kemɨ'ane newaiyari mɨkwa'a nexuriya mɨ'ie, tukari mɨkaxɨwe kanexeiyani. Tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtapare, nekanenukuketɨamɨkɨ.
Ne newaiyari yurikɨ kani'ikwaitɨni, nexuriya yurikɨ kananu'iwani.
Kemɨ'ane newaiyari mɨkwa'a nexuriya mɨ'ie, mɨkɨ nehetsie tiwiyatɨ kaniyuhayewamɨkɨ, neta hetsiena netiwiyatɨ netinehayewa.
Ne'ukiyari mayeniere kwiepa kemɨnerenɨyenɨ'a hepaɨ, ne kenemɨrayeniere ne'ukiyarikɨ, mɨpaɨrita yaxeikɨa kemɨ'ane mɨnetsikwa'a, mɨkɨta kanayenierekamɨkɨ nekɨmana.
'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni paa taheima makane. Xetutsima manana me'utikwaka memukwi, mɨpaɨ pɨka'ane. Kemɨ'ane 'ikɨ paa mɨkwa'a yuheyemekɨ kanayenierekamɨkɨ.
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni Kaperunaumetsie ti'ɨkitatɨ tukita.
Niuki tukari mɨkaxɨwe hepaɨtsita
Hikɨ 'ayumieme teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama yumɨiretɨ me'u'enanaka mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: «'Ikɨ niuki kanikwaniweni. Kepaikɨ pɨyɨwe mi'enienikɨ».
Ketsutsi yu'iyaritsie retimaika memɨniukixiekaikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿'Ikɨkɨ xetetiketamɨrike?
¿Ketiɨyɨwetsɨ xɨka xe'ixeiyanike Yuri Tewi mana 'utimiekame hakewa meripaitɨ mekateitsie?
'Iyari kanihɨkɨtɨni tukari tiyupitɨwame, waiyari 'atsipɨkatiuyuriwe. Tita nemɨtixekuxaxatɨwa ne, mɨkɨ kani'iyaritɨni kanitukaritɨni.
Peru hipatɨ xeme yuri xepɨkate'erie. Ketsutsi matɨari paitɨ kaniwamaikaitɨni kehate mɨkɨ yuri memɨkate'eriekai, meta katimaikaitɨni kemɨ'ane miyetuanikekai.
'Ayumieme tawarita mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ayumieme nepɨtixekɨhɨawe, xewitɨ mɨkayɨwe nehetsɨa mɨye'ani xɨka ne'ukiyari mɨpaɨ katipitɨaka.
Mɨkɨkɨ yumɨiretɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama yukutama mekanitakɨne, hamatɨana mepɨka'u'uwakairi.
'Ayumieme Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta: —¿Xemerita xeteyuwaɨriya xemɨyehu?
Tsimuni Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya yuku'imawatɨ: —Ti'aitame, ¿kepaikɨ rahetsɨa tepɨteyehu? 'Ekɨtsɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe niukiyari pekanexeiyani.
Tameri yuri tekateniuta'erieni, tekamenetimani 'ekɨ Mɨpatsie pekanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xeme nekanixe'anayexei tamamata heimana yuhutame. Perutsɨ xewitɨ xeme kauyumarie hepaɨ kani'aneni.
Mɨkɨ Kura Tsimuni nu'aya 'Itsikariutitanaka kanixatakaitɨni, mɨkɨ kaniyetuanikekaitɨni tamamata heimana memuyuhuta mɨwanɨkai.
